SECOND AMENDMENT
to Service Agreement
by and between
TCS (Private) Limited (the "TCS") and Zameen Media (Private) Limited (the "Zameen")
{Each a Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]

This second amendment (the "Second Amendment") to the Service Agreement dated 25th
October, 2021 further amended through Frist Amendment dated l4 December, 2022
(collectively referred to as the "Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 22
November, 2023.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Agreement for provision of domestic express and overland
delivery/courier services to be provided by TCS to Zameen; and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Agreement as per the terms
and conditions of this Second Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Second Amendment shall come into force on 1st November, 2023 ("Effective

TCS's initials:
Pagelof3
THIS DOCUMENT IS CONFIDENTIAL AND PROPRIETARY

Zameen's initials:

2.

The Term of the Agreement is hereby further extended for a period of one (1) year
commencing from the Effective Date and ending on 31s1 October, 2024 (Term").

3.

The Schedule of Rates specified in Annexure B/i of the First Amendment shall stand revised
and replaced, with effect from 1st October, 2023, by the Schedule of Rates specified in
Annexure B12 appended to this Second Amendment. For the avoidance of doubt, revised
rates as specified in Annexure B/i shall be applicable from 1st October, 2023.

4.

This Second Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement.

5.

All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and shall
continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event
of any conflict, the terms of this Second Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting term
in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning
in this Second Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7.

This Second Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same amendment.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this Second Amendment, having fully
understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses.
